title: dormcraft micropack
description: very light sprinkling of a few mods to over haul progression and add new life to the game
body: Very small pack that adds a decent range of mods, Building, Automation, Bosses, Biomes, Gear, all packed into a very lightweight package. Iron's for wizardry, Cataclysm for bosses, Regions Unexplored for biomes, with a few other fun suprises thrown in.
